bounds.eval_end_rule: min(market holdout end, last GCP holdout minute + 60s)

protocol.design: one-shot frozen holdout; every arm fitted once on all dev hourly rows whose targets finish before the holdout start, then scored on every holdout minute from eval_start; the direct Born-rule readout fits nothing
protocol.models: per-arm StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=1 (direction) / ridge alpha=1 (volatility), fitted once
